objective: Run the final non-publishing release gate for the prepared @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.1 candidate and determine whether it is safe to publish.
context: Issue #43 tracks remediation of the published v0.3.0 default npm install failure. The implementation commit df5aab2efa19f1a735c3d20c017f0b76275765f0 aligned all direct DSH peer/dev dependency pins to the supported official @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 cohort and prepared version 0.3.1. Commit fae8cd8aee7b07159308760d113f4bdec7139996 corrected the official-cohort regression gate so the candidate is materially installed with npm's normal resolver while the very large official DSH coexistence graph is validated with npm's default resolver in package-lock-only mode instead of fully materializing roughly 900 MB of dependencies. This task validates only; it must not publish, tag, or create a GitHub Release.
forbidden_changes: npm publish, npm dist-tag changes, deprecate, unpublish, or any registry mutation
creating, moving, rewriting, or deleting git tags including v0.3.1
creating, editing, or deleting GitHub Releases
package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, CHANGELOG.md, src/**, scripts/**, test/**, agents/**, commands/**, codex/**, statusline/**, .github/**, or any product/workflow implementation file
use of --legacy-peer-deps, --force, --omit=peer, or equivalent peer-resolution bypasses
the user's normal ~/.dsh, official DSH web profile, credential stores, provider key files, or other secrets
validation: Validate this Task Contract first: node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs task docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json

After git pull --ff-only, record exact main HEAD, branch, ancestry, and clean pre-execution git status. Treat fae8cd8aee7b07159308760d113f4bdec7139996 as the prepared v0.3.1 release-target commit; the queued ACTIVE-task commit must never become the package/tag target.
Verify package.json version, src/runtime-identity.mjs RUNTIME_VERSION, and the top CHANGELOG.md release entry are mutually consistent at 0.3.1.
Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and require PASS without changing the lockfile.

Run pnpm run verify:npm-install and require NPM_INSTALL_CONTRACT=PASS candidate=0.3.1 official_dsh=not-run. This must materially install the packed candidate with npm's normal resolver and no peer bypass.

Run pnpm run verify:npm-install:official and require NPM_INSTALL_CONTRACT=PASS candidate=0.3.1 official_dsh=0.1.1-rc.2:resolver-lock. Confirm this mode uses npm's default resolver with --package-lock-only for the official DSH coexistence graph, not --legacy-peer-deps/--force/--omit=peer and not a full materialized official DSH install.
Run the full deterministic sweep: node --test test/*.test.mjs
Run the client build: pnpm run build:client, then restore any tracked generated build artifact if and only if it is a deterministic build side effect; do not retain product diffs.
Run npm pack --dry-run --json and audit package name/version, payload file list, sizes, and absence of ACTIVE task/result/temp/secret/test-only artifacts.
Run npm publish --dry-run --access public from the prepared release-target content only; this is non-publishing and must not mutate the registry.
Run git diff --check and record final git status; validation must leave no tracked product/workflow changes.
Authoritatively confirm @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.1 is absent from the public npm registry. Network/auth ambiguity is BLOCKED, not absence.
Authoritatively confirm remote git tag refs/tags/v0.3.1 is absent. Network/auth ambiguity is BLOCKED, not absence.
Authoritatively confirm no GitHub Release for v0.3.1 exists. Network/auth/tooling ambiguity is BLOCKED, not absence.
Write schema_version 2 Result Contract to docs/agent-results/TASK-V031-FINAL-RELEASE-GATE-result.json with evidence for every item and an explicit overall conclusion V031_RELEASE_READY or BLOCKED.

Stamp and revalidate the Result Contract: node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs result docs/agent-results/TASK-V031-FINAL-RELEASE-GATE-result.json --stamp, then validate the stamped result again before commit.
acceptance_criteria: The exact prepared release target is fae8cd8aee7b07159308760d113f4bdec7139996 and its provenance is recorded separately from the queued task commit.
Version identity is consistently 0.3.1 and frozen dependency installation passes.
The packed candidate materially installs with normal npm peer resolution and no bypass flags.

The packed candidate plus official @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 graph resolves with npm's default resolver in package-lock-only mode and the generated lock proves both @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.1 and @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 were selected.
All deterministic tests pass, client build passes, npm pack audit passes, and npm publish dry-run passes.
No validation step leaves tracked product/workflow changes or unintended package payload artifacts.
@ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.1, remote tag v0.3.1, and GitHub Release v0.3.1 are each authoritatively absent before real publication.
No npm publication/registry mutation, git tag mutation, GitHub Release mutation, peer-resolution bypass, credential exposure, or official DSH state mutation occurs.
Result Contract is validator-stamped PASS and states V031_RELEASE_READY only if every required gate is PASS; otherwise it states BLOCKED with exact blockers.
On completion ACTIVE_TASK.json is deleted and only the authorized Result Contract plus task deletion are committed/pushed.
